body:
Restyle the existing consultation workspace using shared Clean Look surfaces, spacing, link tokens and 36px desktop/44px phone-tablet controls. The three-file scope retains the previously approved appearance assertions. Clinical script and payload behavior match current main exactly; the current RedZoneAlertBanner and read-only bill navigation are preserved by the normal main refresh. No permission, migration, Family, Treatment or TRI2 feature is added.

The final View triage correction supplies a 36px desktop minimum and semantic keyboard focus ring while keeping its server-owned URL guard, underline and 44px mobile minimum. Its existing exact appearance assertion is adapted faithfully under the owner's standing delegated technical authorization; all read-only and URL authority assertions remain. The other original approved style expectations are unchanged.

Validation: all 2,205 frontend tests, full TypeScript, production build and scoped lint/format/diff checks pass. Independent source review also reran all 12 focused tests. Six independent browser checks at 390/768/1440 in both themes verify 44/44/36px targets, keyboard ring, 12.5px text and omission when no server URL exists, with no errors, overflow, writes or navigation. This bounded proof renders the exact source-extracted real Inertia Link with the original scoped styles and production global CSS; it is not a full Clinical/Show, authenticated workflow or populated-prescription UAT claim. Historical whole-page evidence remains separately qualified. Fresh exact-head CI and then-current-main containment are required before merge.
